title: Transition-Block Smoothed 24-Layer Dichroic Stack
scientific_hypothesis: Applying localized smoothing constraints to the highly reactive transition block (layers 12-15) will reduce oscillatory overshooting while preserving the beneficial non-uniform topology discovered in iteration_12, leading to improved convergence stability and potentially higher best_target_score.
design_principle: Gradient-based thickness optimization with bounded step-size modulation on layers 12-15 to prevent abrupt thickness changes that cause spectral oscillations, while allowing full search bounds on outer layers.
proposed_topology: 24-layer alternating stack starting with HfO2 on air side, ending with SiO2 on fused silica substrate side. Exact sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2
design_variables: All 24 layer thicknesses with layers 12-15 constrained to +/-10% change per optimization step
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band
Maximize mean reflectance in 400-700 nm band
Maintain smooth thickness progression in transition block
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness bounds 50-280 nm for all layers
Localized smoothing may improve deposition uniformity in transition region
theory_basis: Thin-film interference theory for dual-band dichroic filters
Transfer-matrix method for coherent multilayer stacks
Gradient-based optimization with localized constraints for stability
expected_advantages: Reduced risk of local minima trapping in transition region
Potentially higher best_target_score than iteration_12 baseline
known_risks: Over-constraining layers 12-15 may prevent discovery of optimal thickness configuration
Smoothing constraint may limit exploration of beneficial non-uniform topologies
execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 dichroic stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence at normal angle. Initialize thicknesses from iteration_12 best candidate: [77.71, 177.76, 65.96, 87.63, 94.31, 100.73, 236.5, 85.64, 126.52, 87.8, 60.22, 87.68, 209.35, 88.73, 63.43, 79.31, 63.65, 84.16, 163.16, 212.54, 63.22, 82.93, 177.9, 68.43] nm. Apply gradient-based thickness optimization with bounds 50-280 nm for all layers. Impose localized smoothing constraint on layers 12-15 (indices 11-14 zero-based) limiting thickness change to +/-10% per optimization step. Evaluate coherent TMM at normal incidence unpolarized. Score candidates by mean transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band and mean reflectance in 400-700 nm band with equal weighting. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1530-1565 nm, 400-700 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band; High reflectance in 400-700 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band; Low transmittance in 400-700 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count <= 30.
revision_reason: Applied feedback directive to restrict step size on highly reactive transition block layers 12-15 to prevent oscillatory overshooting while preserving beneficial non-uniform topology from iteration_12.
